description:
## Question

For each open ticket, one question: does it block the 0.1.0 release? (Decided on the map 'Wayfinder: defk ready for a first Hex release': no full re-priority.)

Scope: the deferred epics (defk-52v, defk-n4r, defk-sve, defk-ulk, defk-96f) and the expansion candidates in docs/verdict.md ('Where defk could grow'), and the children of the support epics (defk-9p6, defk-djy, defk-o08, defk-vcx, defk-w8r). The agent prepares a table of every open ticket with a proposed yes or no and a reason; the maintainer decides each row.

Input from the map: new constructs are allowed under the stability promise, so no expansion candidate must land before 0.1.0 only to protect the promise. Precompiled artefacts (defk-ajw) are not a gate.

Done when: every row has a decision; 'yes' rows become tickets under the map (or are linked as blockers of the release-readiness check); 'no' rows stay where they are, unchanged.
title: Triage: which open tickets block 0.1.0
